notes: Brać is an imperfective verb. Its perfective partner is wziąć. Use brać for ongoing or repeated actions, and wziąć when the action happens once and is completed.
This verb is extremely versatile in Polish. It can mean taking a physical object, but also taking medication (brać leki), taking a shower (brać prysznic), or choosing an option (brać opcję).

senses.definition: To grasp something with your hands and move it to a different place.

examples.translation: I have to take an umbrella because it is raining.
examples.emotion: practical and prepared, looking out at the rainy weather

senses.definition: To accept something that is offered or provided to you.

examples.text: Nie chcę brać pieniędzy od rodziców.
examples.translation: I do not want to take money from my parents.
examples.emotion: earnest and proud, explaining a personal decision
